text.p: Lyonnaise des Eaux said on Thursday that it expected growth in its business and profitability in 1997.

"In the first quarter of 1997, major international water distribution contracts were won in the cities of Manila, Budapest, Cordoba and Maribor, enabling the group to serve almost 65 million people worldwide and confirming its international leadership in this sector," it said in its earnings statement.
"As a result the group is looking forward with confidence to further growth in business and profitability during 1997," it said.

Its profit rose 49 percent in 1996 to 1.35 billion francs on sales of 91.6 billion francs. Lyonnaise said its performance was helped by its strategy to focus on three core lines -- environmental services, communications and construction.
